visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a modern indoor living room with warm, bright lighting, a man wearing a beige zip-up fleece jacket stands while holding a gray ergonomic seat cushion and a smartphone. In the foreground, a woman sits on a gray sofa with her back to the camera, wearing a prominent golden butterfly hair clip. The man gestures with his hands while looking at his phone and talking. (2) The scene transitions to a dark studio setting. The man is now dressed in a skin-colored muscle suit and a bald cap, sitting on a chair. Beside him, the woman wears a white blazer dress and oversized glasses with spiral patterns, holding a red-patterned stick. She rhythmically strikes the man or the cushion he holds as various Traditional Chinese text overlays appear on the screen.

The male voice is mid-range, speaking at a moderate pace with a tone of mild frustration or thought. There is a clear room tone with no background music. (2) The audio track shifts to high-energy, rapid-fire speech in Taiwanese Hokkien by the female voice. Rhythmic, percussive hitting sounds (impact SFX) are introduced, occurring every second or so, punctuating the dialogue. The male voice responds with short, comedic exclamations that are high in arousal. No music is present, but the percussive thuds create a driving rhythm.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Sketches -> Product Slogan
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous variety-show style skit to promote an ergonomic seat cushion and backrest. It starts with a meta-narrative about scriptwriting difficulty and then transitions into a series of comedic demonstrations of product efficacy through rhythmic hitting and high-energy dialogue.
